integrity: Exact cubic-discriminant identity reconstructed using standard-library integer polynomial arithmetic from the same displayed numerator formulas; 90 positive monomials compared against a full explicit certificate; boundary degrees handled separately. 845 finite exact lattice count checks supplement but do not prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only the integral positive two-layer tetrahedral Cayley frusta with unit layer separation in dimension four are classified. The result does not cover arbitrary six-facet smooth four-polytopes, other heights, or higher dimensions. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Real-rooted Ehrhart numerators of height-one tetrahedral Cayley frusta
